name: Summon Fey Spirit
description:
You have lived where the border between our world and the Fey Realm is thin, and you know how to call spirits to your aid.

Once per rest while in natural areas, you may spend 1 minute summoning a fey spirit to aid you. The spirit manifests for one minute in a shape formed from natural objects in the area: leaves, sticks, the bark of a tree, etc. Its knowledge and influence is limited to the natural area you're currently in. It can speak and understand you.

To determine the spirit's behavior, roll Spirit. On a...

  • 1-5: The spirit is a trickster. It will either pester you and/or offer help at an unreasonable price.

  • 6-10: The spirit is friendly and will offer helpful information if able.

  • 🌞: The spirit takes a liking to you. The spirit will follow you and aid you three times within the next day (at times chosen by the GM), granting a +1d bonus to a skill check you make.

  • 💀: The spirit is roused to anger by your request. Check a Condition. The spirit will follow you and interfere with you three times within the next day (at times chosen by the GM), imposing a -1d penalty to a skill check you make.

Describe how you summon the spirit.
